variants.headline: Home-world ship reaches the colony
variants.sub: The colony has received the arrival of a home-world ship.
variants.body:
A ship from the home world has arrived in {colony}. The arrival is a concrete event in the colony's connection with its distant origin. Readers considering {target} should distinguish that fact from assumptions about particular goods, passengers or immediate changes in local supply not specified in this report.

For workers, transport matters through the ordinary life it helps make possible. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.sub: A vessel from the home world has reached {colony}.
variants.body:

variants.headline: The distant connection comes into port
variants.sub: A ship from the home world has arrived in the colony.
variants.body:
A home-world vessel has arrived in the colony. Arrival and the practical disposition of a voyage's business are different subjects. An assessment of {target} should keep the known event clear, leaving unspecified freight, passenger figures and commercial outcomes outside the factual description of the ship's appearance.
